degree_required.value: Graduate of a 2-, 3-, 4-, or 5-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution (per pathway chosen)
degree_required.quote: is a graduate of a 5-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution and has completed at least 2 years of full-time diversified interior design experience; is a graduate of a 4-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution and has completed at least 2 years of full-time diversified interior design experience; has completed at least 3 years of interior design or architecture curriculum from an accredited institution and has completed 3 years of full-time diversified interior design experience; or is a graduate of a 2-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution and has completed 4 years of full-time diversified interior design experience.

accrediting_body.quote: "Accredited institution" means an institution accredited by the Council for Interior Design Accreditation, an accreditation body recognized by the United States Department of Education, or a curriculum or transcript approved by the Board per a registration applicant's application.

degree_level.quote: is a graduate of a 2-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution and has completed 4 years of full-time diversified interior design experience.

school_approval_basis.quote: institution accredited by the Council for Interior Design Accreditation, an accreditation body recognized by the United States Department of Education, or a curriculum or transcript approved by the Board

credential_pegged.quote: the applicant has completed the education and work experience requirements to sit for the NCIDQ examination administered by the Council for Interior Design Qualification, has successfully passed the NCIDQ exam, has maintained an active NCIDQ certification

experience_source.quote: is a graduate of a 2-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution and has completed 4 years of full-time diversified interior design experience.

duration.quote: has completed at least 2 years of full-time diversified interior design experience

exams.name: NCIDQ (National Council for Interior Design Qualification) examination
exams.notes: The Department designates the NCIDQ as its examination; applicants must also maintain an active NCIDQ certification. Applicants have 3 years from filing date to pass.
exams.quote: The Department shall designate as its examination for registered interior designers the National Council for Interior Design Qualification examination.

required.quote: Each applicant for renewal or reinstatement of registration under this Act shall have completed continuing education as set forth by the Department by rule. The Department shall consider the recommendations of the Board in establishing requirements for continuing education requirements but shall be no less than 10 hours of continuing education in the areas of health, safety, and welfare every 2 years.

hours_per_period.quote: no less than 10 hours of continuing education in the areas of health, safety, and welfare every 2 years

period_years.quote: no less than 10 hours of continuing education in the areas of health, safety, and welfare every 2 years

topical_requirements.quote: no less than 10 hours of continuing education in the areas of health, safety, and welfare every 2 years

available.quote: an applicant who is an interior designer currently registered, certified, or licensed under the laws of another state or territory of the United States or a foreign country or province shall, without further examination, be granted registration as an interior designer by the Department whenever the requirements of such state or territory of the United States or a foreign country or province were, at the date of registration, certification, or licensure, substantially equal to or greater than the requirements then in force in this State.

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently registered, certified, or licensed in another state/territory/country whose requirements were substantially equal to or greater than Illinois requirements at the time of original licensure. Fee required; application must be completed within 3 years of filing.
requirements.quote: shall, without further examination, be granted registration as an interior designer by the Department whenever the requirements of such state or territory of the United States or a foreign country or province were, at the date of registration, certification, or licensure, substantially equal to or greater than the requirements then in force in this State.

exists.quote: The Secretary shall appoint a Board of Registered Interior Design Professionals consisting of 5 members who shall serve in an advisory capacity to the Secretary.

name.value: Board of Registered Interior Design Professionals
name.quote: "Board" means the Board of Registered Interior Design Professionals established under Section 6 of this Act.

authority.value: advisory capacity to the Secretary; Secretary shall consider recommendations on guidelines for professional conduct, disciplinary proceedings, and qualifications of applicants; Department may seek Board's expert advice on any matter relating to administration or enforcement
authority.quote: 5 members who shall serve in an advisory capacity to the Secretary

national_certification.quote: has successfully passed the NCIDQ exam, has maintained an active NCIDQ certification

national_association.quote: To adopt as its own rules relating to education requirements, those guidelines published from time to time by the Council for Interior Design Accreditation or its successor entity.

credential_type.quote: "Registered interior designer" means a person who has received registration under Section 8 of this Act.

is_mandatory.quote: Nothing contained in this Act shall restrict any person not registered under this Act from carrying out any of the activities listed in the definition of "the profession of interior design" in Section 3 if such person does not represent himself or herself or his or her services in any manner prohibited by this Act.

title_protection.quote: No individual shall, without a valid registration as a registered interior designer issued by the Department, in any manner hold himself or herself out to the public as a registered interior designer or attach the title "registered interior designer"

scope_protection.quote: Nothing contained in this Act shall restrict any person not registered under this Act from carrying out any of the activities listed in the definition of "the profession of interior design" in Section 3 if such person does not represent himself or herself or his or her services in any manner prohibited by this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in procuring the certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud in procuring the certificate of registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misrepresentations or false promises to influence, persuade, or induce patronage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any misrepresentations or false promises, directly or indirectly, to influence, persuade, or induce patronage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lending name to another for illegal use of the title 'registered interior designer' or associating with any person holding out contrary to this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional connection or association with, or lending his or her name, to another for illegal use of the title "registered interior designer", or professional connection or association with any person, firm, or corporation holding itself out in any manner contrary to this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or seeking to obtain checks, money, or items of value by false or fraudulent representations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or seeking to obtain checks, money, or any other items of value by false or fraudulent representations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of the title under a name other than one's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of the title under a name other than his or her own.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper, unprofessional, or dishonorable conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improper, unprofessional, or dishonorable conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony if the Department determines the person has not been sufficiently rehabilitated to warrant public trust
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction in this or another state, or federal court, of any crime which is a felony, if the Department determines, after investigation, that such person has not been sufficiently rehabilitated to warrant the public trust.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of any provision of this Act or its rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this Act or its rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation by another state, D.C., territory, or foreign nation of an interior design license, certification, or registration on equivalent grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation by another state, the District of Columbia, territory, or foreign nation of an interior design or residential interior design license, certification, or registration if at least one of the grounds for that revocation is the same as or the equivalent of one of the grounds for revocation set forth in this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental incompetence as declared by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental incompetence as declared by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated child abuse/neglect report with clear and convincing evidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services pursuant to the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the registrant has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or its rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or its rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide information in response to a written request by the Department within 30 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide information in response to a written request made by the Department within 30 days after receipt of the written request.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical illness, including deterioration through aging or loss of motor skill, resulting in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process or loss of motor skill that results in the inability to practice interior design with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or attempting to use an expired, inactive, suspended, or revoked registration or the certificate or seal of another registrant or impersonating another registrant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or attempting to use an expired, inactive, suspended, or revoked registration or the certificate or seal of another registrant or impersonating another registrant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing, affixing, or allowing the registered interior designer's seal to be affixed to any interior technical submission not prepared by or under the registrant's responsible control
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing, affixing, or allowing the registered interior designer's seal to be affixed to any interior technical submission not prepared by the registered interior designer or under the registered interior designer's responsible control.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of interior design
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of interior design.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of controlled substances, alcohol, narcotics, or other substances resulting in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other substances that results in the inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety due to physical illness, mental illness, or disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of physical illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, loss of motor skill, mental illness, or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly having a financial interest, or accepting compensation except from clients, that would compromise the registrant's professional judgment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly undertaking any activity or having any financial or other interest, or accepting any compensation or reward except from the registrant's clients, for registered interior design services by the result of those same services, any of which would reasonably appear to compromise the registrant's professional judgment in serving the best interest of clients or the public.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of registered interior design" means the design of interior spaces as a part of an interior alteration or interior construction project in conformity with public health, safety, and welfare requirements, including the preparation of documents relating to building code descriptions, project egress plans that require no increase capacity of exits in the space affected, space planning, finish materials, furnishings, fixtures, equipment, and the preparation of documents and interior technical submissions relating to interior construction.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of registered interior design" means the design of interior spaces as a part of an interior alteration or interior construction project in conformity with public health, safety, and welfare requirements, including the preparation of documents relating to building code descriptions, project egress plans that require no increase capacity of exits in the space affected, space planning, finish materials, furnishings, fixtures, equipment, and the preparation of documents and interior technical submissions relating to interior construction.

value: preparation of building code description documents
project egress plans (no increase in exit capacity)
preparation of interior technical submissions relating to interior construction
methods_authorized.quote: the design of interior spaces as a part of an interior alteration or interior construction project in conformity with public health, safety, and welfare requirements, including the preparation of documents relating to building code descriptions, project egress plans that require no increase capacity of exits in the space affected, space planning, finish materials, furnishings, fixtures, equipment, and the preparation of documents and interior technical submissions relating to interior construction.

credential_tier.quote: "Registered interior designer" means a person who has received registration under Section 8 of this Act.

architect_pathway_available.quote: an applicant who is an architect licensed under the laws of this State may, without examination, be granted registration as a registered interior designer by the Department provided the applicant submits proof of an active architectural license in Illinois.

ncidq_exam_required.quote: The Department shall designate as its examination for registered interior designers the National Council for Interior Design Qualification examination.

value: 3 years curriculum + 3 years full-time diversified experience
education_experience_pathways.quote: is a graduate of a 5-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution and has completed at least 2 years of full-time diversified interior design experience; is a graduate of a 4-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution and has completed at least 2 years of full-time diversified interior design experience; has completed at least 3 years of interior design or architecture curriculum from an accredited institution and has completed 3 years of full-time diversified interior design experience; or is a graduate of a 2-year interior design or architecture program from an accredited institution and has completed 4 years of full-time diversified interior design experience.

nonstructural_scope_only.quote: Altering or affecting the structural system of a building, including changing the building's live or dead load on the structural system.

value: building envelope (exterior walls, coverings, openings, windows, doors, trim, balconies, projections, bay windows, oriel windows, roof assemblies, rooftop structures, exterior glass and glazing)
exit access beyond the exit access component
life safety systems pertaining to fire safety or fire protection of structural elements
fire-rated vertical shafts in multistory structures
excluded_building_systems.quote: "Practice of registered interior design" does not include: (1) The practice of structural engineering ... (2) Services that constitute the practice of architecture ... (3) Altering or affecting the structural system of a building ... (4) Changes to the building envelope ... (5) Altering or affecting the mechanical, plumbing, heating, air conditioning, ventilation, electrical, vertical transportation, fire sprinkler, or fire alarm systems.

residential_practice_exempt.quote: Nothing in this Act shall be construed as requiring the services of a registered interior designer for the interior designing of a single family residence.

interior_decorator_exemption.quote: Nothing in this Act shall be construed as preventing or restricting the practice, services, or activities of ... any interior decorator or individual offering interior decorating services including, but not limited to, the selection of surface materials, window treatments, wall coverings, furniture, accessories, paint, floor coverings, and lighting fixtures

permit_submission_authority.quote: No officer, board, commission, or other public entity who receives interior technical submissions shall accept for filing or approval any interior technical submissions related to services requiring the involvement of a registered interior designer that do not bear the seal and signature of a registered interior designer.

seal_required.quote: Every registered interior designer shall have a reproducible seal, or facsimile, the impression of which shall contain the name of the registered interior designer, the registration number, and the words "Registered Interior Designer, State of Illinois".

responsible_control_defined.quote: "Responsible control" means the amount of control over detailed professional knowledge of the content of interior technical submissions during the preparation as is ordinarily exercised by registered interior designers applying the required professional standard of care.

conflict_of_interest_rules.quote: Knowingly undertaking any activity or having any financial or other interest, or accepting any compensation or reward except from the registrant's clients, for registered interior design services by the result of those same services, any of which would reasonably appear to compromise the registrant's professional judgment in serving the best interest of clients or the public.

business_entity_practice_permitted.quote: Nothing in this Act shall prevent the employment, by a registered interior designer association, partnership, or a corporation furnishing interior design services for remuneration, of persons not registered as interior designers to perform services in various capacities as needed

inactive_status_available.quote: Any registrant who notifies the Department in writing on forms prescribed by the Department may elect to place his or her certificate of registration on an inactive status and shall, subject to rules of the Department, be excused from payment of renewal fees until he or she notifies the Department in writing of his or her desire to resume active status.

continuing_education_topical_focus.quote: no less than 10 hours of continuing education in the areas of health, safety, and welfare every 2 years
